questions.prompt: Which explorer disappeared searching for a lost city in the Amazon in 1925?
questions.fact: Dozens of later expeditions went looking for him, and several of those parties also vanished.

questions.prompt: Which animal has the longest recorded lifespan?
questions.fact: Individuals have been estimated at over 400 years old, dated by chemical markers in the lens of the eye.

questions.prompt: Which trophy is contested annually between Australia and England in cricket?
questions.fact: The urn itself is tiny, about fifteen centimetres tall, and is too fragile to be presented on the field.

questions.prompt: Which film features the Nakatomi Plaza?
questions.fact: The building is a real office block, and its owners still receive requests to film there.

questions.prompt: Which country contains the Iguazu Falls' larger share?
questions.fact: Argentina holds most of the falls, while Brazil is generally agreed to have the better view of them.

questions.prompt: Which novel follows a governess who falls for her employer, Mr Rochester?
questions.fact: The novel was published under the name Currer Bell, and reviewers spent years speculating about the author's sex.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of a checksum?
questions.fact: Bank card numbers include one, which is why a single mistyped digit is usually rejected instantly.
